title: Minecraft Java RCE reported via resource-pack TrueType fonts
summary: On November 22, a public proof-of-concept called minecraft2shell reported a high-severity remote code execution flaw in Minecraft Java Edition: a crafted TrueType font delivered through a server resource pack triggers a native out-of-bounds write in FreeType 2.14.3 and earlier and can execute code on a Windows client. The report lists Java 1.20.5 through 1.21.10 and snapshots 26.1 through 26.4 as affected, while 1.20.4 and earlier and Bedrock Edition are not. Mojang still ships lwjgl-freetype 3.4.3 and has no official patch, according to the post; the community m2sfix 1.0.0, published November 24, disables hinting through a Java agent or mod. The claim comes from a Telegram post and a public PoC, not an official advisory, so the exact affected-version and execution details are not independently confirmed here.
